description: This source file defines indexing classes and a provider for OrchardCore's AutoroutePart, including logic for indexing content items and their contained items for routing purposes.

classes.name: AutoroutePartIndex
classes.description: Represents an index for autoroute parts, including document ID, content item ID, route path, publication status, containment info, and JSON path.

classes.name: AutoroutePartIndexProvider
classes.description: Provides indexing logic for AutoroutePart, handling content item removal, publication, and contained content indexing within OrchardCore.

methods.name: RemovedAsync
methods.description: Handles cleanup when a content item is removed, adding it to the _itemRemoved set if no active version remains.

methods.name: PublishedAsync
methods.description: Handles indexing when a content item is published, removing the AutoroutePart if it no longer belongs to the content type.

methods.name: Describe
methods.description: Defines how content items are indexed, including conditions for indexing removed or disabled parts.

methods.name: PopulateContainedContentItemIndexesAsync
methods.description: Recursively indexes contained content items for routing, including handling relative and absolute paths.
